column3: “opened” renders “uncovered,” and “he bowed all the way to the ground” renders “he bowed and prostrated himself on his face.”
“your way was contrary to me” renders a rare verb (yarat) whose meaning is uncertain.
“If she had not turned aside” renders “perhaps she turned aside”; the meaning is uncertain.
“the city of Moab” may also be read as the name “Ir-moab.”
“anything at all” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“the high places of Baal” renders “Bamoth-baal,” and “a portion of the people” renders “the edge of the people.”
